claim.purpose: Reconcile v0.91.8 planning, sprint umbrellas, issue readiness, and parallel execution without starting downstream implementation

initial.title: [v0.91.8][WP-01][readiness] Reconcile plans, sprint umbrellas, and parallel execution
initial.goal: Make v0.91.8 executable with maximum safe parallelism and no unowned, stale, duplicated, or structurally incomplete work.
initial.required_outcome: Every canonical plan, sprint umbrella, child issue, dependency, card, validation contract, and parallel lane has reviewed truthful readiness before implementation starts.
declared_scope: v0.91.8 canonical planning and feature documents
live v0.91.8 issue and sprint-umbrella graph
parallel session assignments, collision boundaries, and integration order
authority_boundary: Issue #5594 is the active WP-01 readiness authority
ADL owner binaries provide live issue and PR truth
Typed C-SDLC v2 records provide lifecycle authority
initial.task_boundary: Reconcile and prove v0.91.8 readiness only; do not execute downstream implementation.
deliverables: reviewed execution-readiness report and reconciliation matrix
parallel session assignment and dependency map
ready or not-ready disposition for every sprint
bounded repairs to stale planning, routing, ownership, and readiness truth
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Live issue and PR inventory is reconciled with every canonical v0.91.8 planning, feature, handoff, review, and release document
AC-2: Every sprint umbrella exists with a complete non-overlapping child set, dependencies, and terminal acceptance criteria
AC-3: Every issue has truthful ownership, version, dependency, card, design, validation, and readiness disposition
AC-4: Parallel lanes have disjoint write scopes or explicit stack order, a four-writer cap, and one integration queue
AC-5: Runtime v3 parity, multi-agent work, acceptance, external shadows, cutover, and release-tail work are routed without duplication or scope expansion
AC-6: Focused docs, structured-data, links, issue-routing, dependency, protected-path, and diff validation passes
dependencies: current v0.91.8 planning package and live issue inventory
repo_inputs: typed C-SDLC issue projections and session ledger
non_goals: product, Runtime, C-SDLC, demo, Observatory, or infrastructure implementation
new feature scope or one issue per finding
initial.plan_summary: Run parallel read-only truth inventories, synthesize one canonical reconciliation, repair bounded planning/readiness defects, validate, review, and publish the WP-01 gate before downstream execution.

steps.action: Collect live issue, PR, sprint umbrella, card, and canonical-document inventories in parallel
Synthesize the dependency graph, collision map, critical path, and sprint readiness dispositions
Repair bounded canonical planning, issue routing, umbrella, ownership, and readiness defects
Run focused validation and exact-revision review, then publish the readiness gate

risks: stale issue state can make prose-only readiness misleading
overlapping sprint children can create parallel write collisions
card preparation can accidentally become downstream implementation
external-agent output can be mistaken for lifecycle authority
invariants: no downstream implementation before reviewed readiness
no more than four writable issue actors after WP-01
one serialized integration and merge queue
external shadows remain read-only evidence producers
no AWS and no raw gh
stop_conditions: live issue truth cannot be obtained through ADL owner binaries
another active claim or worktree owns #5594
a required repair would widen scope into implementation
sprint ownership cannot be made non-overlapping without operator decision
review_prompts: Does every sprint have one real umbrella and a complete non-overlapping child set?
Do canonical docs agree with live issue, PR, card, and dependency truth?
Are parallel assignments collision-safe and dependency-correct?
Did WP-01 avoid implementation and scope expansion?
Are external-agent and merge authorities correctly bounded?

validation_lanes.proof_role: Parse and validate v0.91.8 YAML and JSON planning surfaces
Verify local links across touched v0.91.8 documents
Verify issue, label, umbrella, dependency, and PR routing through ADL owner binaries
Verify diff hygiene, protected scope, and typed lifecycle consistency

initial.failure_policy: Fail closed on stale live truth, missing or overlapping sprint ownership, incomplete cards or contracts, write-scope collisions, unsupported readiness claims, scope expansion, AWS use, or raw gh use.
